sloka: त्वया शेषोओ जनश्चैव समाश्वास्यो यदाऽनघे ।किमिदानीमिदम् देवि करोषि हृदि विक्लबम् ॥२-४४-२५॥
transliteration: tvayā śeṣoo janaścaiva samāśvāsyo yadā'naghe ।kimidānīmidam devi karoṣi hṛdi viklabam ॥2-44-25॥

translations.english: O sinless lady, O queen when you are overcome by fear, how can you console others?
